content:
maya: urgent — ACME reporting p99 spikes from dedicated pool `acme-prod` starting ~2025-03-15 10:40 UTC during billing rollover. p95 up ~800ms -> p99 ~2.2s, some 502/504 seen. Customer says it started right after their billing window kick (high concurrency). traces: https://redwood.internal/t/trace/ACME-xxx :rotating_light:

zach: on it. can you paste pool id + model + min/max? any recent deploys? :eyes:

maya: pool id: acme-prod-01, model: open-llama-70b-quant, min=4 max=32, no model deploys in the last 24h. customer repro steps: 50 concurrent chat requests w/ 1024 tokens prefix, p99 jumps and occasional 502s when pool <8.

nina: quick glance at infra logs — I see attach_latency and image_pull_timeouts correlated at 10:41-10:50. node group gpu-n1 had `image_gc` events and ephemeral disk pressure around same window.

infra-bot: autoscaler: scaleup requested for pool acme-prod-01 (desired 8) at 2025-03-15T10:41:22Z — provisioning nodes and starting image pull tasks.

leo: this smells like disk/image churn -> cold image pulls delaying container start -> GPUs not attached fast enough -> requests queue/p99 spike. also possible KV cache miss storm once new replicas attach.

zach: hypothesis confirmed by metrics: image_pull_wait increased from ~50ms -> 1.8s during spike; attach_handshake_latency jumped; queue length spiked. KV cache hit rate dropped because many new containers lost cache.

maya: customer is asking for immediate mitigation and long-term fix. they prefer not to switch to hosted but want stability.

zach: immediate mitigations we can apply now (low-risk):
- bump min_pool for acme-prod-01 4 -> 8 to avoid cold pool in billing window
- trigger pre-pull job on gpu nodes to cache model image before attach
- enable routing fallback to a smaller quantized variant for 5m in case of repeat spike

nina: commands i ran to patch min pool & start pre-pull:```sh
# patch autoscaler min replicas
redwoodctl pools patch acme-prod-01 --min-replicas 8
# dispatch pre-pull job to node group
kubectl create job prepull-acme-20250315 --image=prepull:latest -- /bin/sh -c 'pull-layer open-llama-70b-quant'
```

leo: dispatched a short-lived warmup job that pre-pulled layers to all new nodes in gpu-n1. also temporarily disabled image GC aggressive threshold on that node group.

maya: after warmup started (~10:52) customer reports p99 down to ~450ms and no 5xxs after 10:58. :thumbsup:

zach: next steps / postmortem actions:
- investigate root cause of disk pressure (node image GC config + ephemeral disk sizing)
- add a scaleup lifecycle hook to pre-pull model image before marking replica healthy
- add metric `image_pull_wait` alert at p95 > 1s during scaleup windows
- consider increasing default min replicas for customers with high billing-window concurrency patterns or offer scheduled pre-warm option.

nina: opening follow-up ticket SPT-4821 to track infra changes (increase disk, GC tuning, lifecycle pre-pull). tagging infra & node-provisioning teams.

leo: long-term: also evaluate KV cache warmup snapshotting so new replicas can bootstrap KV cache quickly and avoid miss storms.

maya: customer update: sent summary and next steps, they accepted the min_pool bump and warmup playbook. will monitor through next billing window.

zach: closing this thread for now — reopening if p99 repeats. thanks team. :white_check_mark:
